question: What work, author, section, and chapter are identified in this colophon?
premises: The work is Prāsādamaṇḍana, an architecture treatise.
It was composed by Śrī Sūtradhāra Maṇḍana.
This concludes the first chapter on mixed characteristics.
inference: The colophon identifies the first chapter on mixed characteristics in Prāsādamaṇḍana by Śrī Sūtradhāra Maṇḍana.
plain_english: Thus ends the first chapter, on mixed characteristics, in the architectural treatise Prāsādamaṇḍana composed by Śrī Sūtradhāra Maṇḍana.
